incident.observed_by_user: Authenticated candidate v139 remained on 'Carregando seu LTS…' while header still showed WIP35-v136.
incident.root_cause: Candidate layers referenced lexical let/const bindings from index.html as window properties. v138 render guard checked window.D, which was never the real lexical D, so render stayed blocked. Earlier smoke artificially populated window.D/window.S, producing a false green for this path.
incident.fix: v140 adds a same-origin lexical bridge for S, D, V, brl, fmt, esc, num and today, preserving index.html fallback unchanged. When the real lexical D is ready, the candidate can recover a render that was blocked during startup.

guardrails: Do not promote index.html before user homologation.
Do not claim authenticated visual E2E.
The v139 user failure is a real homologation incident and must remain part of release history.
Future browser smoke must not use synthetic window.D/window.S to claim boot readiness.
